practitioner_paragraph: How to read the results. Three questions are answered in order. First, the checks for leaked labels and for failed synthetic recovery did not trip. Second, P1 asks whether PINN-KAN is no more than 10 % worse than the best tuned learner at g1: 22 of 40 held-out conditions agreed, 30 were needed, so the comparison is undecided, which is not a finding of equality. Third, K1 asks the same of the extracted law against PINN-KAN at g4: 20 of 40, 32 needed. Persistence was beaten in 40 of 40 conditions at g1.
